"""RoboPaint strict episode controller; all movement uses the public Robot API.

The practice calibration is in robot_paint.py and cal2.py. plan.py decomposes

  python gen.py --corrections corrections.json

def run(plan, checkpoint, colors=None):
    import robot_paint as rob
    checkpoint.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    M=.227185

        depth=np.interp(width_mm,
            [1.5,1.8,2.65,4.35,7.4,12.9,15.4,18.6,20.8],
            [1,2,4,6,9,12,13,14,14.7])/1000

    sequence=list(range(len(plan)))

        sequence=[i for c in colors for i,s in enumerate(plan) if s['color']==c]
    loaded=None

        if (checkpoint/str(i)).exists():continue
        s=plan[i]

        points=np.array([xyz(row) for row in s['points']])

        p.to([p.p[0],p.p[1],.045],.07)
